title: tectaria crinigera
intro: Tectaria crinigera, commonly known as the 'Crinigera fern', is a species of fern within the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria crinigera include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
